articles.summary: MALMÖ, Sweden, July 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY) (“Oatly”, the “Company” or the “Group”), the world’s original and largest oat drink company, today announced financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
articles.title: Oatly Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
